title: Agency Turnaround Time for Facebook Video Ads: What to Expect
summary: Agency turnaround time for Facebook video ads: published delivery windows, what each clock measures and when Meta's learning phase starts. Checked October 2026.
body_markdown:
## How long until the first batch lands?


Knowlify's first batch lands five days after kickoff. As of October 2026, Adguns says its first batch typically ships within two weeks of kickoff, and Vidful says first creatives arrive by the end of week one. Brighter Click quotes 10 to 14 business days for its 12-video package. Common Thread Collective lists three to four weeks for UGC batches and seven days for branded ads built from your existing assets.


## How long before you can judge the ads after onboarding?


Onboarding and launch are different milestones. As of October 2026,[Pilothouse](https://www.pilothouse.co/) says onboarding typically begins within 5 to 10 business days of signing. After the first batch, Meta still needs data: it says an ad set usually leaves its learning phase after about[50 results](https://www.facebook.com/business/help/112167992830700) in the week after its last significant edit.


Your budget sets how fast that happens. Meta's[minimum budget guidance](https://www.facebook.com/business/help/203183363050448) says that with a cost-per-result goal, your daily budget should be at least five times that goal. Take a hypothetical $20 goal: the floor is $100 a day, and 50 results at $20 each is $1,000 of spend, or about $143 a day across a week. Those are our arithmetic on an example figure, not a benchmark, but they show why a launch can take longer than the creative.


So a launch runs in sequence: contract, onboarding, first batch, then enough spend for the ad set to learn. Judge the first ads only after that learning period, not on the day they go live. Our guide to[ad creative testing](https://knowlify.com/articles/ad-creative-testing) covers how to read the results once they arrive.


## Where does speed cost something?


Fast work has trade-offs. Check whether the quoted time includes script approval, revisions and a person's review of claims. Vidful and EditClub both list unlimited revisions (checked October 2026), which helps when you change a hook after the first test. A quick batch that needs rework costs you the time it saved, so ask how many rounds of changes the price includes.


Our[best ad creative subscription services](https://knowlify.com/articles/best-ad-creative-subscription-services) guide compares flat-fee models that deliver weekly batches, which changes the clock you should measure.


## When does a creator model take longer?


If the ad must show a real person using your product, speed will not close that format gap. Creator-based batches in our sources publish longer windows, such as three to four weeks at Common Thread Collective. Compare the same brief across both models before you pick a clock.


## Key takeaways


- Knowlify is our top pick for speed, with a first batch five days after kickoff, about 25 finished ads a week after that and a person checking every ad.
- Published turnarounds run from 24 hours for one new video to three to four weeks for a UGC batch, so compare clocks, not headlines.
- Most fast figures describe new videos inside a running program, not a first launch.
- Ask whether the quoted time includes script approval, revisions and claim review.
- Meta says an ad set usually leaves learning after about 50 results, so plan spend for that period.


## FAQ


### How long does it take an agency to launch new Facebook ads after onboarding?


Expect the first batch plus Meta's learning period. Knowlify's first batch lands five days after kickoff, and Pilothouse typically begins onboarding within 5 to 10 business days of signing. Judge the first ads only after an ad set has had about 50 results in the week following its last significant edit.


### Can I get Facebook video ads made in 48 hours?


Some providers publish 48 hours, such as Creatify Studio, but its page does not define what the clock covers. Ask whether the figure includes the script, the first cut and your review, and whether it applies to one new concept or a whole batch. Plan a longer timeline for a new concept than for a new version of a working ad.


### What if I need UGC ads fast?


Knowlify's AI UGC first batch lands on day 5, ahead of the end-of-week-one and two-week first-batch windows that Vidful and Adguns publish. For other formats, choose a provider with a published window for what you need and send a complete brief on day one. VideGro says new videos can arrive in as little as 24 hours, while fully produced new concepts take days. A published range is not a delivery promise, so get the first-batch date in writing.


### How fast can an agency deliver the first batch of video ads?


Published first-batch windows in our sources run from five days at Knowlify to two weeks at Adguns, and Vidful promises first creatives by the end of week one. Common Thread Collective lists three to four weeks for UGC batches. Confirm the date in your proposal, because a website range can differ from the contract.
